about: Cuffe Parade is Mumbai's southernmost residential enclave - a narrow peninsula of reclaimed land jutting into the Arabian Sea at the very tip of South Mumbai. Created from land reclaimed from the sea in the 1970s as part of the Back Bay Reclamation Scheme, it is today one of the most exclusive and expensive residential addresses in India. The iconic Maker Towers, the World Trade Centre, Badhwar Park's bungalows and the sea-facing towers along Cuffe Parade Main Road define an area that is simultaneously a diplomatic quarter, a corporate address and a supremely quiet residential neighbourhood. Whether you need a dentist near Maker Towers, a salon near the World Trade Centre, or a reliable plumber in Badhwar Park - Mumbai96 has verified listings with real reviews, direct numbers and everything a Cuffe Parade resident needs to find the right service fast.

character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Cuffe Parade is the quietest loud address in Mumbai. It has the most expensive real estate in the city, the most exclusive residents and the most stunning sea views - and yet it is almost entirely unknown to the average Mumbaikar. There are no tourist attractions here, no famous markets, no nightlife strips. What there is, is space. And silence. And the sea on three sides. And the kind of unhurried, dignified quality of life that money can buy in Mumbai but that very few addresses actually deliver. The residents of Cuffe Parade are a fascinating mix: retired IAS officers in Badhwar Park bungalows, senior executives in Maker Towers penthouses, diplomats in the WTC-adjacent residences, and a growing number of young ultra-high-net-worth professionals who have discovered that Cuffe Parade's Metro Line 3 connectivity makes it possible to live at the tip of South Mumbai and still get to BKC in 25 minutes. It is a neighbourhood that rewards those who seek it out - and keeps its secrets from those who don't.
